snippet.title: Compass Release Trailer - Out Now on Meta Quest and SteamVR
snippet.description:
Explore long lost skies in Compass, an open-world piloting adventure about finding your way through uncharted clouds. Maneuver your ship through hazardous floating landscapes, solve puzzles with your grapples, upgrade your vessel, and lead the Caravan forward.

OUT NOW on Meta Quest and SteamVR

Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experience...
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/43...

#compassvr #vr #adventure #flying #steam #metaquest
